customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be among the best in the market, with excellent installation and reliable performance. They appreciate its premium appearance and water quality, noting it makes a noticeable difference in water purity. While some customers consider it worth the price, others feel it's not value for money, and opinions about water taste are mixed.

reviews.author: Ramesh
reviews.title: Great product
reviews.body: Prompt delivery from Amazon and quick installation from UC.

reviews.author: INDRAJEET
reviews.title: Excellent RO
reviews.body: Value for money and overall good experience

reviews.author: Vishnu S.
reviews.title: Better at its price
reviews.body: Quality is good as expected. Can't see the water level in the concealed tank. The water dispensing knob is not smooth if it gets stuck we can't take water from tank. Otherwise water quality and taste good.

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Important to know that the purifier is a little big and check your area measurements before
reviews.body: Nice product delivery was good installation agent was really nice helped me move stuffs and guided through the product value for money installed the filter told how the filtration works water water pressure was low fixed that and battery life was great

reviews.author: Anand stephen
reviews.title: Good purifier with peace of mind
reviews.body: Writing this review after few weeks of usage . Looks classy Does the job and 2 year warranty is peace of mind . And the mobile realtime connectivity is superb . Tested my water tds levels . Before its around 550 .after filteration its around 58 . So better job on filtering . Installation is smooth as well the person knows what he is doing . So peace of mind on that 😊 Recommended one for new buyers .
